seo.title: Service Areas in Greater Victoria | RNC Landscaping
seo.description: RNC Landscaping serves 13 Greater Victoria communities, from Sidney and North Saanich to Langford, Sooke and Metchosin. Find your area and get a free quote.

lede: Thirteen municipalities across Greater Victoria, from the Saanich Peninsula to the West Shore and Sooke. Each area page covers local conditions, the tree and watering rules that apply there, and nearby work.
intro: A garden in Sidney and an acreage in Highlands need different plans. Soils, exposure, deer, water supply and tree bylaws all change from one municipality to the next, so each area has its own page instead of one list of place names.
Pick your municipality on the map or in the list below. If you are not sure which one your address falls in, tell us the street when you ask for a quote.

map.heading: Thirteen municipalities
map.lede: A schematic map, not to scale. Select an area to see its local rules, conditions and nearby projects.

list.heading: Area guides
list.lede: Each guide summarises what is different about that municipality, with links to the official rules.

sections.heading: How service areas work
body: We work across all thirteen municipalities on this page. Every quote starts the same way, wherever you are.

items.title: Tell us where and what
items.body: Choose your municipality in the [free quote form](/free-quote/) and describe the work. Area pages link to the form with your municipality already filled in.

items.title: We check the local rules
items.body: Before quoting tree work, digging near trees or irrigation, we check the bylaw and watering rules for your municipality and say in the quote if a permit may be needed.

items.title: The plan fits the place
items.body: Plant choices, watering and scheduling are planned for your lot's exposure, soil, deer pressure and water supply, not copied from another job.

sections.heading: Local rules differ
body: Each municipality has its own tree bylaw, with different protected species, size thresholds and permit steps. CRD watering rules apply only where a property is on the regional supply, which matters in rural areas where many homes use wells. Each area page links to the official source and shows when we last checked it. Read our [winter pruning and tree permit guide](/resources/winter-pruning-and-storm-prep/).

sections.heading: Not on the list?
body: If you're nearby, [get a free quote](/free-quote/) and choose Other, or [contact us](/contact/). See [our services](/services/).

cta.heading: Get a free quote for your property
cta.body: Choose your municipality and describe the work. We reply with questions or a quote, never a price list.
